Use `interaction-design`, `responsive-design` and `accessibility-audit`.

For each critical workflow define trigger, response, state, feedback, errors, recovery and keyboard/touch alternatives. Specify reduced-motion behavior, responsive panel collapse, mobile capability boundaries, focus behavior, announcements, contrast and non-drag alternatives for timeline operations.

Update `docs/design/06-INTERACTION-AND-STATES.md`, `07-ACCESSIBILITY.md` and `08-RESPONSIVE-STRATEGY.md` if authorized. No code. Request owner review.
